title: The youngest a star can be and still host a body (GEN.686)
status: planetGen defaults: the ages are the old class tables' minimums (tuning.PLANET_CLASSES age_ranges, planetGen values with no source), now asked of the body's stored conditions instead of its class letter. A body needs the time its settling takes: a young star can host a giant, an airless rock, a small barren world, or a molten one; a world with air, water and a settled surface needs the star to be old enough for that, longer on a star that evolves slowly.

molten.words: a young, hot or still-outgassing world

watered.words: air and liquid water long enough to settle

frozen.words: a glaciated world, the oldest tier
